what: A giant title pinned beneath the hero is hidden by the following sections, shows only through a 200px gap with a cleared background, and is pushed up -10rem (scrub, power1.out) while that gap passes from the bottom to the top of the screen — a gap where the signboard letters show again between sections

options.[data-fx-part=title]: Fixed title (child) — laid underneath at the bottom of the screen
options.[data-fx-part=gap]: Gaps left in the background (children, multiple allowed) — each gap is pushed further by shift
options.shift: Push distance while passing through one gap, default -10rem
options.ease: Curve, default power1.out (the original gave no curve, so GSAP’s default applies to scrub)
options.media: Screens where the push motion is enabled, default (min-width: 768px) — show-through effects work at all widths in CSS
options.--fx-bottom: Bottom end of the title (via style), default 0

note: Sections after the title must be painted with a background color to cover the title (a section with no background also leaves a gap). The title is fixed at z-index -1, so if the element a part is attached to, or its ancestor, makes a new layer with transform · filter · z-index, the part is trapped inside that layer. Attach it to an element that makes no layer, at main · body level. To keep the title in the flow on phones, use position: static in the consuming css

from.where: index.html .hm-hero__copy + .hm-peek (the giant serif hero title shows through the 200px gap between News and store info, -10rem) — original --animate-copy-y tween
